operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table PlayerInfo and SeasonStatus; column ELITEID, CSS_rank, GP_greater_than_0, sum_7yr_GP/TOI — must be double-quoted verbatim.
SeasonStatus has NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op, drop_unique_duplicates must no-op (no unique cols).
birthyear declared DATE but storage class integer (years 1972-1983); TS dispatches to Number(scale=4) because first element parses as int — not Date.
birthdate declared TEXT, stores ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings; TS String fuzzer will not produce date-shaped values.
height_in_inch TEXT stores feet-inch strings like 5'5" (apostrophe+quote); String fuzzer charset a-zA-Z 0-9() cannot reproduce.
SEASON TEXT stores 'YYYY-YYYY' ranges; String fuzzer treats as generic text.

PlayerInfo.height FK -> height_info.height_id (16 rows, values 65-70s); PlayerInfo.weight FK -> weight_info.weight_id (46 rows, 154-220). Parent PKs are small ints, child values are drawn from parent's FINAL filtered column.
SeasonStatus.ELITEID FK -> PlayerInfo.ELITEID; SeasonStatus has 5485 rows vs 2171 parents, so many-to-one (duplicates expected).
All columns notnull=0, null_rate=0.0 — no NOT NULL constraints to trip; no CHECK/UNIQUE declared.
No composite keys, no self-references, no dangling FKs, no views/triggers in DDL.
Small tables (16, 46, 2171, 5485 rows) — full read, no rowid sampling needed.
height_info/weight_info are pure lookup tables with no FKs; PlayerInfo and SeasonStatus are the only FK-bearing tables.
operator_ts_expectations: height_id, weight_id, ELITEID, height, weight, birthmonth, birthday, draftyear, draftround, overall, CSS_rank, sum_7yr_GP/TOI, GP,G,A,P,PIM,PLUSMINUS -> Number fuzzer: uniform in [-10^4,10^4] then +-1/+-2 perturbation; implausible magnitudes (e.g. height=8000) drive FN on range predicates.
birthyear (DATE, int elements) -> Number(scale=4) per spec 3.3 rule 3; produces years far outside 1972-1983, breaking year-range queries.

PlayerName, birthplace, nation, position_info, shoots, overallby, TEAM, LEAGUE, GAMETYPE, SEASON, GP_greater_than_0, height_in_inch, birthdate -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings with contamination; 'yes'/'no', 'L'/'R'/'-', 'Regular Season'/'Playoffs' become garbage -> FN on equality/IN.
String fuzzer adds str(i+1)/str(i-1) for int-like elements and %-stripped variants; helps LIKE queries but not exact enum matches.
FK columns (PlayerInfo.height/weight, SeasonStatus.ELITEID) draw from parent's final values with replacement -> duplicates in child; joins still work but counts differ from original.
SeasonStatus has no PK, so no PK dedup; 5485 rows of random combos -> many duplicate (ELITEID,SEASON) pairs, plausible for many-to-one but breaks DISTINCT-count gold.
Number fuzzer's list_max quirk (overwrites max(el)+1 with full-range max) means even with elements present, fresh draws span [-10^4,10^4] -> implausible values dominate.
String fuzzer's length range [min len, max len+1] from 5 sampled originals; for short enums like shoots (len 1) range is tiny, for PlayerName (len ~15) range ~[10,20].
Date fuzzer not used here (birthyear goes to Number); no Time/Bool/Bit columns.
p=0.2 default with 0.3 chance of p=0 per instance; max_l0 cap 30 for non-PK columns -> limited fresh-value diversity, many repeats of 5 sampled originals.
Expected misses: FN from implausible numeric magnitudes and garbage strings; FP from missing ties (no PK on SeasonStatus) and from FK duplicates.
